map.短链接生成器。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: Short link generator. An online tool built for developers, runs entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
map.短码 = 字符集[ hash(长链) 逐位取模 ]（同链稳定）: Short code = alphabet[hash(long URL) mod base, per position] (stable for the same URL)
map.解析：短码 → 301/302 跳转原 URL: Resolve: short code → 301/302 redirect to the original URL
map.短链的核心是「短码 ↔ 长链」的映射表。本工具对长链做 FNV-1a 哈希，再用: A short link's core is a "short code ↔ long URL" mapping table. This tool hashes the long URL with FNV-1a, then maps a deterministic mixing stream into the selected alphabet one character at a time: the same URL with the same settings always yields the same code, while different URLs yield different codes (hash collisions remain possible, so a real service needs a unique index). The batch index also feeds the hash, so a multi-code batch is stable and each code differs. Use 302 (temporary) for redirects to count every click; 301 (permanent) is cached by browsers. Drop ambiguous chars like 0/O and 1/l from the alphabet. This tool only generates mapping codes, with no server storage or redirect.
map.把长 URL 缩短为自定义短码（模拟）。: Shorten a long URL into a custom short code (simulated).
map.演示短链映射原理：输入长链接得到短码与对应关系，便于向同事解释短链服务是怎么工作: Demonstrate the short-link mapping principle: enter a long URL to get a short code and the mapping, making it easy to explain to colleagues how a short-link service works.
map.长链 `https://ex.com/a/b/c?x=1` → 短码 `ex.a: Long URL `https://ex.com/a/b/c?x=1` → short code `ex.am/ab3kQ` (demo, not a real redirect).
map.需唯一索引保证不冲突。: A unique index is needed to guarantee no collision.
map.和真实短链服务差在哪？: How does it differ from a real short-link service?
map.真实服务需要服务端存储「短码 ↔ 长链」映射，并在访问时返回 301/302 跳: A real service needs server-side storage of the "short code ↔ long URL" mapping and returns a 301/302 redirect on access while logging click stats. This tool only generates strings locally, with no server storage or redirect capability, so the generated codes can't be accessed by others—it demonstrates the encoding step, not the full service.
map.同一条长链会生成不同短码吗？: Do I get different codes for the same long URL?
map.不会。长链内容参与哈希，同一 URL、同一设置（长度/数量/字符集）必得同一组短: No. The URL content feeds the hash: the same URL with the same settings (length, count, alphabet) always produces the same set of codes. Batch rows also include their index, so each code in a batch differs.
